top_creatures.label: Pitched-chest winged wyrm (frost wyvern)
top_creatures.why: Forward-pitched chest, a head that glances to new targets on a stepped clock, a three-hit combo whose third strike has the longest buildup, and a 360-degree ice shockwave that applies a Frozen buff and can be jumped over. Should read as watchful at 375 wide (design claim, not tested).
top_creatures.keep: forward chest; stepped head glance; three-hit combo with heavier finisher; full-circle shockwave with a jump window
top_creatures.change: our wing count and shape, palette, element, head crest, names
top_creatures.ref: assets/common/entity/wild/aggressive/frostwyvern.ron lines 4-6; assets/common/abilities/ability_set_manifest.ron lines 938-945; assets/common/abilities/custom/frostwyvern/iceshockwave.ron lines 9, 13, 16, 18; assets/common/abilities/custom/frostwyvern/triplestrike.ron line 68; voxygen/anim/src/bird_large/idle.rs lines 27, 69

top_creatures.label: Wyvern family template (four elements)
top_creatures.why: Flame, frost, cloud and sea wyverns share one ability-set shape: a bomb primary, the same three-hit combo as secondary, and a shockwave plus a spray in the extra list. Only the element and names change.
top_creatures.keep: one set shape per family; element swap
top_creatures.change: our element names and effects; per-family spawn weight as zone data

top_creatures.label: Storm wyrm (cloud wyvern)
top_creatures.why: Lightning bomb, lightning shockwave and lightning spray in the same slot pattern; the element reads on screen from the first move.
top_creatures.keep: one readable element per move; a bomb that opens the fight

top_creatures.label: Ink tide wyrm (sea wyvern)
top_creatures.why: Ink bomb, ink shockwave and ink spray: a water-themed family with its own moves for a sea encounter.
top_creatures.keep: family moves tuned to the terrain (water)
top_creatures.change: our water hazard is our own, not ink

top_creatures.label: Frost colossus (gigas frost world boss)
top_creatures.why: A world boss whose ability set includes a frost summon of two NPCs placed five to ten units away with the boreal summon loadout, and whose drop is a lottery of an armour set or a crafting ingredient drawn as a 3-to-4 count range.
top_creatures.keep: boss that calls escorts; lottery drop with a count range
top_creatures.change: our escort count (capped at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3); our drop pool; names

top_creatures.label: Cultist warlord (dungeon elite)
top_creatures.why: An elite whose hand weapon is one of two at random (sword or hammer), with its own large loot table. One elite per dungeon that plays differently each run.
top_creatures.keep: random weapon pick at spawn; dedicated large loot table

top_creatures.label: Summoned boreal warrior (rank five escort)
top_creatures.why: A summoned NPC that gets a random ranged or melee weapon with the rank-five full-skill preset; its ability set has a hammer branch (single strike, dash, leap) and a bow branch (double strike, shotgun, trap). Escalation by preset, not a level number.
top_creatures.keep: preset rank as the escalation dial; random weapon pick; two-branch ability set
top_creatures.change: our rank names and escort limit

looks.label: Emissive baked glow on figures
looks.technique: Per-model glow value raised to the third power, scaled, lit by a glow term and by how much the surface faces the glow direction, added to reflected light

looks.label: Flag-based glow on LOD objects
looks.technique: Warm tint added to the surface colour when a glow flag is set in the LOD object shader

looks.label: Quality ladder on loot and inventory slots
looks.technique: Eight rungs mapped to slot images, gold at Legendary, purple at Epic

looks.label: Particle glow at night (comment only)
looks.technique: Comment says particles glow at night; code not read

looks.label: Sparks flicker in a fixed rhythm (comment only)
looks.technique: Comment says sparks stop glowing for part of each cycle, four times a second; code not read

looks.label: Stepped head glance (bird idle)
looks.technique: Target changes on a floored clock with pseudo-random offsets; correction to AU055: steps about every 2 s of global time, not a half-second clock

looks.label: Wyvern chest pitch
looks.technique: Fixed forward rotation of the chest in the wyvern branch of the idle
